name: inverted sit-up on apparatus
description: A sit-up performed while hanging head-down with the feet secured on an inversion apparatus, challenging the abs.
instructions: Secure your feet and ankles on a suitable inversion apparatus and make sure you can hang steadily head-down.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands lightly near your head.
Pause briefly near the top without jerking your neck.
Curl your trunk toward your legs without swinging, then lower slowly to the hanging position.
